panels.figure_caption: Signal intensity measurements performed on T1WI and STIR images. Signal intensity measurements were performed by identifying anatomical structures on T1WI and placing circular regions of interest on STIR images within areas of bone marrow edema (red circle) and adjacent muscle (white circle). The maximum signal intensity values were used for both tissues. For muscle, easily measurable muscles near the area of interest, such as the pectoralis major or intercostal muscles, were selected. Each measurement was performed 3 times, and the average value was used for analysis. The edema intensity ratio was calculated using the following formula: Edema intensity ratio = Maximum signal intensity of bone marrow edema/maximum signal intensity of muscle.
